Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, pt As Object, cs As Object, ch As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:B5").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array("k", "v"), Array("a", 1), Array("b", 2), Array("a", 3), Array("c", 4))))
    Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:B5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("I3"), "PT")
    pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField
    pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum
    ws.Range("D1:D5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2, 3, 4, 5))
    Set cs = ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions.AddColorScale(3)
    ws.Range("F1:G1").Merge
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(300, 10, 200, 120).Chart
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B5")
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Tried = TypeName(ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions.Application) & " " & TypeName(ws.Range("D1:D5").FormatConditions.Parent)
    Case 1
        Tried = TypeName(wb.IconSets.Application) & " " & TypeName(wb.IconSets.Parent)
    Case 2
        Tried = TypeName(wb.PivotCaches.Application) & " " & TypeName(wb.PivotCaches.Parent)
    Case 3
        Tried = TypeName(ws.PivotTables.Application) & " " & TypeName(ws.PivotTables.Parent)
    Case 4
        Tried = TypeName(pt.PivotFields("k").PivotFilters.Application) & " " & TypeName(pt.PivotFields("k").PivotFilters.Parent)
    Case 5
        Tried = TypeName(ws.Range("J5").PivotCell.RowItems.Application) & " " & TypeName(ws.Range("J5").PivotCell.RowItems.Parent)
    Case 6
        Tried = TypeName(ch.Axes.Application) & " " & TypeName(ch.Axes.Parent)
    Case 7
        Tried = TypeName(ch.SeriesCollection.Application) & " " & TypeName(ch.SeriesCollection.Parent)
    Case 8
        Tried = ws.Range("F1").DisplayFormat.MergeCells & " " & ws.Range("D1").DisplayFormat.MergeCells & " " & IsNull(ws.Range("E1:F1").DisplayFormat.MergeCells)
    Case 9
        Tried = TypeName(ws.Range("D1").DisplayFormat.Style) & " " & ws.Range("D1").DisplayFormat.Style.Name & " " & ws.Range("F1").DisplayFormat.Style.Name
    Case 10
        Tried = cs.ColorScaleCriteria(1).FormatColor.ColorIndex & " " & cs.ColorScaleCriteria(2).FormatColor.ColorIndex & " " & cs.ColorScaleCriteria(3).FormatColor.ColorIndex
    Case 11
        Tried = TypeName(ws.PivotTables.Add(pt.PivotCache, ws.Range("M3"), "PT2")) & " " & ws.PivotTables.Count & " " & ws.PivotTables("PT2").TableRange1.Address
    Case 12
        Tried = TypeName(ws.PivotTables.Add(pt.PivotCache, ws.Range("M3"))) & " " & ws.PivotTables(2).Name
    Case 13
        Tried = TypeName(ws.PivotTables.Add(PivotCache:=pt.PivotCache, TableDestination:="R3C13", TableName:="PT3"))
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Queries(ByVal path As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, q As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path, UpdateLinks:=0, ReadOnly:=True)
    Set q = wb.Queries(1)
    Queries = TypeName(wb.Queries.Application) & " " & TypeName(wb.Queries.Parent) & " " & TypeName(q.Application) & " " & TypeName(q.Parent) & " " & q & " " & q.Name
    wb.Close False
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal path As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 13
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    s = s & "@@@" & Queries(path)
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
